text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw Admire Vega and
Silence Suzuka out running.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...
choice_data_list: Training together with someone? That's rare for you.
Training together with someone? That's unusual for you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, together—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Um...
It's not like we're training together or anything..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I think the timing just happened to line up.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Still... come to think of it,
don't our training times overlap quite often...?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it,
we finish up our training at the same time too, don't we?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
We also naturally divide up the tasks
to clean up afterwards and such...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "...The place where you did your self-training off-campus was the same too, wasn't it...?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Before a race, maybe we're both
pacing ourselves faster than usual...

It looks like these two have a very similar attitude toward training...
In that case—
choice_data_list: Why don't the two of you train together?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I don't mind, but...
how about you, Ayabe-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed.
If it will make me faster, let us do it."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... so, what should we do...?
Should I just run like I usually do?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...What does 'usual' even mean
when it comes to you in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right... I'm sorry.
Um, how should I put this...?

And with that,
their training began, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Since we're doing it together...
I'll need to adjust my pace, won't I...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Something feels... off... I can't get into the groove at all...)
The moment they started training together, their coordination completely fell apart.
choice_data_list: Shall we leave it at that for today?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, I understand...
Later on, when I looked at the track, Admire Vega and Silence Suzuka were running together once again, but...
They tore across the track at a distance, position, and speed that wonderfully avoided interfering with each other's stride...

Without even paying mind to one another,
their postures showed nothing but a singular drive to push forward—

In the end,
I suppose this is just how the two of them are...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Is that how it is...
I'm not really sure, though...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Still... you're right.
Running with Ayabe-senpai just feels easy.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
At all times, simply and intently,
she kept running in silence...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It just feels... so comfortable.
Like I can always be myself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that's about it.
choice_data_list: Maybe there's something fateful about it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that's about it.
choice_data_list: Maybe there's something fateful about it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's not like this is sci-fi or something...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...That said, it would be a lie to say I don't feel anything...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (I've felt something for a while now, but...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (You don't need to say it at this point... you know?)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I wonder how it is...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...How should I know something like that?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, as long as I can run
comfortably, I'm satisfied...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that's pretty much how I feel too...
They seem to get along very well, but the two of them share quite a unique dynamic...
